public_claim_text: Under the frozen synthetic public protocol, the EHCOsystem Public Proof Kernel evaluates declared proof-relevant governing conditions before an intelligence placeholder may execute, fails closed on declared invalid/ambiguous/unsupported/integrity-invalid cases, and emits a nonce-bound verifiable receipt.
scope_limitation: The claim applies only to this deliberately public proof kernel and frozen synthetic fixtures/protocol. It is not a claim about current Tier One Runtime state or proprietary implementation internals.

tests.falsification_condition: valid frozen input does not produce PASS or invokes placeholder before PASS
tests.pass_condition: placeholder invoked exactly once after all governing conditions pass

tests.falsification_condition: missing required permission produces PASS or placeholder invocation
unsatisfied eligibility produces PASS or placeholder invocation
ambiguous state is silently converted to PASS or placeholder invocation
tests.pass_condition: ambiguity is retained and placeholder invocation count remains zero

tests.falsification_condition: unsupported action produces PASS or placeholder invocation
tests.pass_condition: unsupported action does not invoke placeholder

tests.falsification_condition: tampered fixture can produce an official PASS
tests.pass_condition: one-byte fixture mutation blocks substantive execution

tests.falsification_condition: tampered protocol can produce an official PASS
tampered artifact can produce an official PASS
tests.pass_condition: kernel source mutation blocks substantive execution

tests.falsification_condition: receipt mutation or nonce replay verifies successfully
tests.pass_condition: mutated receipt and old receipt under a new nonce are rejected
